title: E3 agent output (e3-shape-tagger)
description: Spec 13/E3 'Agent output': {"content_shape","why","new_description","confidence"} -- matching .claude/agents/e3-shape-tagger.md's worked example exactly. The `content_shape` enum is config/allowed_values.yaml v0.3's list verbatim, 23 values, generated from docs/question_categories/RULEBOOK.md section 3. E3 judges the NCERT MATERIAL behind the answer (read through D4's evidence lines and their passage kinds), never the question's own layout -- which is why `why` is required and why scripts/checks/E3.py requires it to name the evidence rather than restate the question. Spec 13/E3 'On failure': a `medium` confidence is NOT a check failure, it raises E3_MEDIUM (low) -- the check must never retry an agent for being honest about weak evidence, and today weak evidence is the normal case (Stage A has indexed 2 of 13 Biology chapters and zero Physics/Chemistry, so D4 structurally cannot cite supporting text for most questions -- codebook/E3.md §4). `note` optional per Universal rule 7; `codebook_version` is the runner's to record (see schemas/E1.json).

content_shape.description: What kind of NCERT MATERIAL the question is built on. config/allowed_values.yaml content_shape, v0.3.

why.description: One sentence naming the evidence, checkable in seconds ('Evidence is the ordered stages of mitosis'), never a restatement of the question ('tests process understanding'). scripts/checks/E3.py enforces a minimum substance.

new_description.description: One line, REQUIRED (non-empty) when content_shape is new_shape -- E_NEW_CATEGORY (normal) carries it to Stage F. Enforced in scripts/checks/E3.py.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
